title: The seeded compiler: from 408 bytes to omc, and what a fixpoint proves
summary: Drake grew the Omega compiler from 408 hand-written bytes: seed0 builds hex1, hex1 builds asm2, asm2 builds om4, om4 builds omc, and omc rebuilds itself to the same bytes. I'll show you the full rebuild (under a second) in a disposable copy, matching the pinned hash, and a negative control proving a fixpoint shows consistency, not correctness: a changed source reaches its own fixpoint too.
goal: Rebuild omc from the seed in a disposable copy, match the pinned hash, and state what the fixpoint does not prove.
key_steps: Copy seed/ to a temporary directory (the script rewrites tracked files)
Run sh seed/omega-from-seed.sh there and read every PASS line
Compare the rebuilt seed/out/omc sha256 with the pin
Compile a program with both compilers and compare the bytes
Change the compiler source and see that it reaches a different fixpoint

example.code:
note extra.om: appended to a copy of omc.om as a negative control. omc never calls it
fn zzextra to int
ret 7
end
example.output:
omc sha256 befb8199db8c4bca188a494dfaac2a6f0ee5c36fcea11188c75666c55fce8a1d

rebuilt omc equals the pin: yes
== 3. the rebuilt compiler and the committed one make the same program bytes
compile rc=0 and rc=0
hello binaries identical: yes
== 4. negative control: a changed compiler source reaches a fixpoint of its own
om4-built equals omc-built: yes
stage2 equals stage3 (a fixpoint): yes
mutant fixpoint equals the pin: no
RESULT PASS

common_mistake: Treating the self-rebuild as proof of correctness or as independent verification. It proves the binary matches this seed and source; correctness comes from referees, fixtures and gates, and independence would need a different lineage. Also: never run omega-from-seed.sh in a shared clone; it rewrites tracked files.
evidence_note: Full seed rebuild run on Linux AArch64 in a temporary copy at omega-mv 19f014f2; rebuilt omc sha256 equals befb8199...8a1d; reproduced byte for byte. Not diverse double compilation, not a correctness proof, and the repository gate tests/gates/run.sh seed was not run here.
